svg.title: Class skills: APIs & back-end — Layered REST APIs with Express and ASP.NET, JWT authentication, role-based access control and input validation. Data — Relational modeling in MySQL and SQL Server, versioned migrations, transactions and ORMs (EF Core, Sequelize). Quality — Automated tests with node:test, regression tests for calculations, Conventional Commits and a pull request workflow.
